figmaCorrections.issue: Variable Text/Hint is defined as #374151 in get_variable_defs but generated code emits #6b7280 for hint/placeholder/caption usages (search placeholder, col-head, profile role, pagination captions).
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Reconcile the Text/Hint token: either redefine it to #6b7280 (its actual emitted value) or stop binding hint usages to it. The current definition is misleading for live comparison.

figmaCorrections.issue: Card uses raw hex #e2e8f0 and raw radius 14px — the only non-tokenized stroke/radius on the screen, while the inner table correctly uses Stroke/200 (#e5e7eb) + radius-lg (12).
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Tokenize the card border and radius (e.g. Stroke/200 + radius-lg or radius-xl) so the card and table share the system, removing the raw values.

figmaCorrections.issue: Language switcher ('English') uses Roboto Medium 12 — the only non-Noto-Sans typeface on the screen, violating the DBIM/Noto Sans standard.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Change the language switcher type to Noto Sans Medium to keep the entire screen on the gov standard typeface.

figmaCorrections.element: Masthead 'Ministry of Social Justice…' line color
figmaCorrections.issue: This line emits #1f2937 despite being bound to the Text/Dark variable (#374151); a hardcoded constant overrides the token.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Bind the line to the intended token value (#374151) or define a token for #1f2937 so the masthead colors are consistent and tokenized.

figmaCorrections.issue: Header 'Ministry/Department' aligns items-start while the two Grant headers align items-center — inconsistent vertical alignment within the same header row.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Use a single consistent vertical alignment (items-center) across all three column headers.

figmaCorrections.issue: Frame layer is named 'ADMIN / MANGAGE MINISTRY' (sic — 'MANGAGE').
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Rename the layer to 'ADMIN / MANAGE MINISTRY' to fix the typo.
